sources.name: The Rundown AI / Supertools
sources.next_action: Excluded from Chairman Queue: /submit-a-tool returned 404 on 2026-09-17. No free submission route verified on the tools directory. Advertising route is paid and is not authorized. Reopen only when a valid free submission route is evidenced.

sources.name: Launch Llama
sources.evidence: Launch Llama confirmed that the ToolScout listing was submitted successfully and is under manual review. The confirmation states that the listing goes live after review and that the owner will be notified by email.
sources.next_action: Submission completed and badge verified. Wait for Launch Llama manual review, then verify https://tools.launchllama.co/products/toolscout is publicly live before marking the opportunity live. Do not resubmit.

sources.name: Best of AI
sources.next_action: Open the homepage, choose Sign In (or Join Free if no account), then Add Tool. Direct /tool/add returns HTTP 401 and 'You must be logged in' to anonymous visitors, using a 404 illustration. Listing form and free submission eligibility remain unverified after sign-in. Do not pay or assume publication.

sources.name: launched.tools
sources.next_action: Free listing requires badge verification before it goes live. Keep blocked under ToolScout no-reciprocal-badge policy; do not buy expedited placement.

sources.name: Nextool AI
sources.evidence: The canonical free-review route returns HTTP 200 and exposes the free submission fields, but the owner encountered a client-side DOM exception ('Failed to execute removeChild on Node') on 2026-09-17. Independent rendering did not reproduce the error, so the route is live but not consistently usable. No machine-readable free submission endpoint was verified.
sources.next_action: Suppress from Chairman Queue while the free-review frontend is unstable. Radar should recheck the canonical free route later and only return it to Human Required after a consistently usable browser path is verified. Do not buy the $45, $145 or $600 promotion packages.

sources.name: Stremit
sources.evidence: Stremit emailed confirmation that ToolScout was approved and is now live and discoverable by the Stremit community. The approval email links to the public ToolScout profile.
sources.next_action: Listing approved and live. Monitor attributed sessions, outbound activity and backlink value. Claiming the page is optional and should only be surfaced if owner editing becomes useful.

sources.name: Launching Next
sources.next_action: Wait for the free editorial review. Do not buy the $99 Fast-Track. Verify the public Launching Next listing after approval before marking live.
sources.evidence: Launching Next confirmed the free submission is in queue with an estimated wait of about 4 months. A $99 Fast-Track option was offered for 1-business-day review, but it is not authorized under ToolScout free-by-default distribution policy.

sources.name: IndexNow
sources.next_action: Automatically submit newly discovered ToolScout URLs to IndexNow and track successful API acknowledgements.

sources.name: TinyLaunch
sources.next_action: Official JSON API verified. Setup still requires authorized email OTP authentication, a maker profile, a real category id and a compliant logo asset before automatic submission can be enabled.

sources.name: Listed Startups
sources.next_action: REST publishing contract and ToolScout payload are validated. Await explicit authorization to register an agent identity and obtain LISTED_STARTUPS_TOKEN; then allowlist automatic audited publication.

sources.name: IndieTool
sources.next_action: API submissions consume credits, so keep the API disabled under ToolScout zero-cost policy. IndieTool also offers a free listing route that requires embedding its badge; do not install that reciprocal badge without explicit approval.

sources.name: StartupHub.ai
sources.next_action: Official agent submission API verified but uses credits/authentication; keep disabled under zero-cost policy unless free credits are available.

sources.name: agenttool.sh
sources.next_action: Automatically submit ToolScout once for agent-readiness scanning through the verified no-auth API, then track the published AgentGrade result.

sources.name: Ora
sources.next_action: Run one free public Ora scan for ToolScout, publish its agent-readiness surface into Ora discovery, then monitor the verified score and fixes.

sources.name: PeerPush
sources.evidence: PeerPush confirmed ToolScout was added to the publishing queue at position #3166 with an estimated wait of about 1 month and 23 days. PeerPush will email when the product goes live.
sources.next_action: Wait for the PeerPush publication email, then verify the public ToolScout listing before marking live. Do not resubmit.
